player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Wo symbol ne '{symbol}', na wo move numbers daa {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 or O2, O4).

Botae: Di nkunim wɔ forming a line of three classical marks (solidified from superpositions).

Sɛnea Wo Bɛdi:
- Wɔ kwaadaa biara, fa spooky mark si squares mmienu ahodoɔ wɔ format '[a,b]'.
- Marks yi yɛ entangled, na labeled sɛ 'X1 / X1' or 'O4 / O4'.
- Wo ntuu fa spooky marks si square a wɔdeɛ collapse (solidified).

Collapse Rule:
- Sɛ wo move yɛ cycle wɔ entanglement graph, ɛ collapse automatically.
- Spooky mark biara wɔ cycle no mu turns into classical mark wɔ ne mu baako.
- Any dependent spooky marks nso collapse.

Nkunim:
- Game no bɛba awie sɛ player bi wɔ classical marks mmiɛnsa wɔ kwan.
- Sɛ players baanu nyaa line wɔ collapse koro no ara, ɔnoa ne max move number ketewa no di nkunim.

Example move: '[0,4]' fa spooky mark si cells 0 ne 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Adansedie a enni mu. Fa '[a,b]' di dwuma.
invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ntwerɔdeɛ a enni mu anaa ɛboro so.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Nkwammoaa no mu biako ayɛ den dedaw.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} faa ne symbol si superposition kwan cells {pos_a} ne {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition ada. Cell ({r}, {c}) aba bɛyɛ {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition a ɛwɔ cell a etwa resolved. Cell ({r}, {c}) seisei {symbol}.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} no di nkonim wɔ nkontaabu a ne bo yɛ den mu!
